_meta.purpose: Symbols/cells taken to their FILINGS and found CORRECT. Suppressed from sweep_analyze so a settled question does not resurface every run — the same reason detect_con_copy.py suppresses TATACOFFEE. Each entry records WHY the sweep flagged clean data.
_meta.rule: suppression is per (symbol, quarter) where known, else whole-symbol with a reason

CUPID.why_flagged: the comparison site INTERMITTENTLY prints Total Income (revenue + non-operating other income, sometimes + a one-off fair-value gain) instead of Revenue from Operation; its own control quarter reads the correct row, so it is an unstable site-side artefact, not a stable alternate concept

SELMC.why_flagged: whole-crore display rounding on a ~1-30cr base

ESSARSHPNG.why_flagged: whole-crore display rounding on a ~5cr base

BALLARPUR.why_flagged: whole-crore display rounding on a ~2-3cr base
BALLARPUR.open_note: BALLARPUR 2024-03-31 detres read is UNRELIABLE — its 'standalone' revenue matches our CONSOLIDATED slot and neither PAT slot matches; likely a CIRP-gap catch-up artefact. Not adjudicated; avoid as a control.

BSE.why_flagged: Screener's 'Sales' = the filed 'Revenue from operations' PLUS Investment income, a line BSE Ltd's own statement excludes from operating revenue. Reproduces the flagged -23.2% worst / -18.0% median BY CONSTRUCTION (206.61 + 62.40 investment income = 269.01 ~ Screener's 269). A concept difference, not our data being wrong.

MTNL.why_flagged: RESTATED-vs-AS-FILED timing. MTNL reclassifies large amounts between 'Revenue from operations' and 'Other Income' from one filing to the next WITHOUT changing PAT — the Sep-2025 filing restates Jun-2025 from 51.66 to 145.12 and Sep-2024 from 158.80 to 251.22, identical PAT either side. Screener tracks the latest restatement; we correctly store as-filed (trap T-E).

MMTC.why_flagged: row confirmed correct on three filings spanning the whole flagged range, zero restatement. The source of the cited -31.5%/-39.0% could NOT be identified — Screener's own MMTC figures round to whole crores (too coarse) and Total Income is a ~99% gap (too large). Recorded as UNRESOLVED-source rather than guessed; the ROW is not in doubt.
